body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one adjacent willing ally.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary Poison or breathing-related numerical penalty until the start of your next turn. The target also reduces its next incoming Acid Damage by 1 during that time.

surges.html: The target may move 1 unit out of a cloud or liquid.
Protect both yourself and the ally.

rider.title: Adaptation - Chimera
rider.html: Assume Filter (upkeep 0): your first exposure each round to a harmful gas cannot apply an ordinary Poison Condition; its Damage and other effects remain.
